notes:
Snapshot:
- Mid-market analytics SaaS: in-app product assistant + churn prediction insights; heavy use of short multi-turn chat and embedding-based similarity search.
- Current provider: NimbusAI (proprietary LLM API). Migration goal: validate Redwood Hosted parity, then move to Dedicated (VPC) for cost predictability and EU residency.

Recent activity (concise timeline):
- 2026-01-30: Lead created; initial qualify with Alex. Good fit: product must keep existing UX and latency tight.
- 2026-02-10: Technical discovery with infra + ML; collected sample dataset (3k chat sessions + 12k embedding vectors).
- 2026-02-20: Hosted API demo (Alex, Priya). Discussed openai-style compatibility shim. Fireflies ff_20260220_9001.
- 2026-03-05: Hosted POC started (seeded production prompts). Ran automated regression harness comparing Redwood->Nimbus outputs. Fireflies ff_20260305_9012.
- 2026-03-09: Regression summary: ~6% structured-output failures (tables, CSV-like export formatting); 2% semantic rerank flips. Logged REG-3301.

Technical requirements / targets:
- Workloads: sessioned chat with KV cache, embeddings (768-d) for similarity, reranker microservice for search result ordering.
- Performance targets: sustain 75 qps for chat, 95th pct latency <= 300ms for quick prompts; embedding batch target >= 250 docs/s on Dedicated.
- Data residency: EU subset must stay in EU region; Dedicated VPC acceptable if contractual clause included.
- Auth: SSO (SAML), SCIM, org RBAC, KMS for envelope encryption.

Compatibility & migration notes (what we learned):
- Strategy: run Hosted as compatibility layer emulating NimbusAI call patterns; use prompt and function-call mapping to achieve parity. If good, move to Dedicated; else iterate.
- Findings: Redwood Hosted handles openai-like endpoints; deterministic sampling defaults differ (tokenizer + sampling) which impacts list/CSV outputs and tabular alignment.
- Regression types: formatting (missing trailing commas, newline normalization), reranker order flips in edge cases, function-calling STRUCT outputs slightly different key casing.
- Mitigations tested: stricter stop tokens, explicit schema prompts, small temperature adjustments, post-processing normalization. Post-processing reduced formatting failures from 6% -> 1.5% in A/B. Ticket INF-1189 tracks engineering follow-ups.

POC plan & ask:
- Extend Hosted POC to 5 days to cover edge-case prompts. SE to deliver prompt-mapping guide (expected 2026-03-14).
- If mapping + post-processing acceptable, schedule Dedicated perf baseline (SE + infra) and draft 12-month reserved pricing.
- Need cost comparison Hosted vs Dedicated for 180-220M tokens/month. Alex requested model-specific delta by 2026-03-16.

Commercial notes:
- Prefers staged commitment: small hosted trial then 12-month Dedicated if POC passes. Wants clearly defined rollback and fallback policies during migration window.
